# 初始条件 and the find bar

Open this page, press `E` for the editor and `Ctrl+F`, and type 初始 into
the find bar. The word stands on the same line as the count at the bar's
right end, whatever face draws it, and no part of it is cut off. Then drag
over the words under the bar: with the bar open a drag still selects.

Set `cjkFont=` in `settings.ini` to a face of your own (SimSun, a face
with tall lines such as Microsoft JhengHei) and look again.

## 初始 in running text

轴对称无旋流时 $\partial_\theta=0,u_\theta=0$，但积分测度不是平面二维，
初始速度由实际面面积确定。The initial value 初始 appears in **bold 初始**,
in *italic 初始*, in a [link to 初始](#初始-in-running-text) and in `初始`.

$$dV=r\,dr\,d\theta\,dy,\qquad dA_{\rm rev}=2\pi r\,ds$$

> 当前网格是 $\Delta\theta=5^\circ$、周向一个单元的 wedge。初始网格不变。
